decisions.reason: Relocating lower main-board connectors does not change the interboard connector types, pinouts, roles, or power-chain semantics.
The source concerns lower connectors on the main-board layout, not battery or interboard connector accessibility on the power board.
The connector relocation preference does not change the specified four-layer stack.
The source rearranges connectors and components within the main board but does not change its dimensions or prototype dimension flexibility.
The source addresses main-board connector placement and does not alter the power board's form factor, mounting, or enclosure fit.
Connector relocation within the main board does not alter the number or functional separation of project boards.
The source does not mention or necessarily alter the ESP32 antenna's edge placement or clearance.
The physical relocation of lower main-board connectors does not change the sensor-board connector inventory, pin assignments, count, or consolidation policy.
The layout preference does not change the monitored rails, monitor device, channel count, or measurement coverage.
The source does not identify any panel-control connector or change the required control connector inventory or signals.
The connector placement preference does not change the charge-status display method, charge connector, resistor values, or population rules.
